TridentNotebook.note: Notebook id/name resolved with item_map; Fabric workspace ids are ignored.

SparkJobDefinition.note: Activity-level arguments and conf are dropped (reported).

Copy.note: Lakehouse files/tables only; column mappings (translator) are dropped (reported).

WebActivity.note: url-based requests only; credentials are never imported.

WebHook.note: Callback URL is sent as callBackUri in the request body.

ExecutePipeline.note: Pipeline resolved with item_map (id or name).

Until.note: timeout becomes the activity timeoutSeconds policy.

unsupported_hints.Lookup: Use a sql activity (DuckDB over the lakehouse) and read activity('<name>').output.firstRow / .rows.
unsupported_hints.GetMetadata: Use a script or sql activity to list files / read table metadata.
unsupported_hints.Filter: Filter inside an expression (e.g. a sql activity or for_each with an if).
unsupported_hints.Delete: Use a script activity (python) that removes the files.
unsupported_hints.Script: Fabric Script activities run SQL against a warehouse connection; use a sql activity (DuckDB) or a spark_job/notebook activity.
unsupported_hints.AzureFunction: Use an http activity against the function URL (with a secret reference for the key).
unsupported_hints.RefreshDataflow: Dataflows Gen2 are a Fabric service and are not part of the open runtime.
unsupported_hints.Office365Outlook: Send e-mail through an alert channel or an http activity against your mail API.
unsupported_hints.Teams: Post to Teams with an http activity against an incoming webhook (store the URL as a secret).
unsupported_hints.Validation: Use an until activity polling with a sql/script activity.
unsupported_hints.SqlServerStoredProcedure: Not available; run the logic in a notebook or sql activity.
unsupported_hints.PBISemanticModelRefresh: Power BI semantic models are a Fabric service.
unsupported_hints.Databricks*: Databricks activities need a Databricks workspace; run the notebook on the OLCF compute fabric instead.
unsupported_hints.HDInsight*: HDInsight clusters are not part of the open runtime.
unsupported_hints.Synapse*: Synapse artefacts are not part of the open runtime.
unsupported_hints.AzureML*: Azure ML activities are not part of the open runtime.
unsupported_hints.Kusto*: KQL / Kusto activities are a Fabric service.
unsupported_hints.Custom*: Custom (Azure Batch) activities are not supported; use a script activity.
